shared: positive regulation of type II interferon production
positive regulation of dendritic cell cytokine production

reading_1.theme: Dendritic cell cytokine responses to pathogens
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover dendritic cell IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF production in response to protozoa, framed as the cytokine output of C-type lectin receptor (Dectin-1/2, DC-SIGN) pathogen recognition.

reading_2.theme: Dendritic cell lectin sensing driving cytokine production
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are dendritic-cell cytokine output (IL-12, GM-CSF, induction of IFN-gamma), which primes type 1 responses. This output sits downstream of C-type lectin receptors (Dectin-1/2, DC-SIGN) recognising fungal and protozoan pathogens.

shared: positive regulation of myeloid leukocyte mediated immunity

reading_1.theme: Neutrophil activation, degranulation and antimicrobial response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover neutrophil degranulation and myeloid effector activation via complement receptors, framed as the deployment of the granule antimicrobial arsenal by recruited, formyl-peptide-stimulated neutrophils.

reading_2.theme: Neutrophil granule biology and antimicrobial effector response
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe neutrophil degranulation and myeloid effector activation, the release of the antimicrobial granule cargo that neutrophils build during maturation and deploy on formyl-peptide-guided recruitment.

shared: obsolete catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission
obsolete regulation of catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission

reading_1.theme: Dopamine and catecholamine synthesis and reuptake
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are dopamine biosynthesis and catecholamine uptake, framed as monoaminergic neurotransmission and its synaptic regulation.

reading_2.theme: Catecholamine synthesis and synaptic reuptake
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover dopamine biosynthesis and the regulation of presynaptic catecholamine metabolism and reuptake. Here they are the transmitter-supply side, coupled to monoamine (dopamine/norepinephrine) membrane transport.

shared: negative regulation of morphogenesis of an epithelium
regulation of branching involved in mammary gland duct morphogenesis
epithelial cell proliferation involved in mammary gland duct elongation
Developmental Lineage of Mammary Stem Cells
epithelial cell differentiation involved in prostate gland development
regulation of branching involved in prostate gland morphogenesis
positive regulation of mammary gland epithelial cell proliferation
Developmental Lineage of Mammary Gland Myoepithelial Cells
Developmental Lineage of Mammary Gland Alveolar Cells
mammary gland branching involved in pregnancy
Developmental Lineage of Mammary Gland Luminal Epithelial Cells

reading_1.theme: Branching morphogenesis of glandular and respiratory epithelia
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cast mammary and prostate (and reproductive) gland development as instances of epithelial branching and glandular differentiation, driven by the same mesenchymal-epithelial FGF signalling that builds lung, salivary and lacrimal glands.

reading_2.theme: Branching morphogenesis of glandular epithelia
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe mammary and prostate gland epithelial development, differentiation and branching, framed as instances of epithelial-mesenchymal branching morphogenesis shared with lung, salivary and other glands.

shared: establishment of protein localization to chromatin

reading_1.theme: Chromatin remodeling and ADP-ribosylation at DNA double-strand breaks
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover nucleosome remodeling and assembly, PARP-driven ADP-ribosylation and recruitment of proteins to chromatin. Here they open and restore chromatin at DNA breaks so that DSB sensing and the choice between NHEJ and homologous recombination can proceed.

reading_2.theme: Chromatin remodelling at DNA double-strand break repair
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are chromatin-level events, meaning nucleosome reorganisation, protein recruitment to chromatin, and ADP-ribosylation regulation, that make DNA double-strand breaks accessible to and signal for homologous recombination and NHEJ repair.

shared: protein localization to perinuclear region of cytoplasm
obsolete proteolysis involved in protein catabolic process

reading_1.theme: Misfolded protein triage via aggresomes and selective autophagy
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover recognising, unfolding and deubiquitinating misfolded proteins (Josephin/ataxin-3) and moving them to the perinuclear region. This is the upstream triage step that feeds aggresome assembly and disposal by aggrephagy, microautophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

reading_2.theme: Misfolded protein aggregation and its autophagic clearance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe misfolded-protein recognition, oligomerization, perinuclear sequestration and Josephin DUB/ER-phagy processing, framed as the protein-quality-control front end that feeds aggregates into aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

shared: amyloid-beta clearance by cellular catabolic process

reading_1.theme: Amyloid-beta clearance and amyloid fibril formation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe regulation of amyloid-beta clearance by cellular degradation, the removal side that counterbalances amyloid fibril formation.

reading_2.theme: Amyloid-beta clearance and amyloid fibril formation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cellular clearance of amyloid-beta and its regulation, opposing amyloid fibril formation and complemented by transcytotic clearance.

shared: obsolete positive regulation of protein exit from endoplasmic reticulum
regulation of retrograde protein transport, ER to cytosol
obsolete regulation of protein exit from endoplasmic reticulum
obsolete protein exit from endoplasmic reticulum

reading_1.theme: ER protein quality control and secretory exit
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe ER retention, quality-control compartment, demannosylation and ER-associated retrograde transport, framed as quality control of proteins that have been targeted and inserted into the ER.

reading_2.theme: ER protein targeting, quality control and export
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are ER quality control after entry, meaning mannose trimming, ER retention, retrotranslocation for degradation and controlled ER exit, following the SRP-dependent and tail-anchored targeting and insertion of proteins into the ER in the additional set.

shared: establishment or maintenance of cell polarity regulating cell shape

reading_1.theme: Actin remodeling for filopodia, polarity and adhesion
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover filopodium formation, cell polarity and postsynaptic actin organization downstream of EPHB and RHOF. This is protrusion control that connects to actin bundling and crosslinking and to integrin-ILK focal adhesion and spreading.

reading_2.theme: Rho-family GTPase control of neuronal actin and growth cones
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover EPHB and RHOF-driven actin remodelling, filopodium control and postsynaptic actin organisation, framed as neuronal cytoskeletal shaping alongside RND GTPases and semaphorin-induced growth cone collapse.

shared: negative regulation of double-strand break repair via nonhomologous end joining
regulation of telomere maintenance in response to DNA damage

reading_1.theme: DNA topology and repair at replication forks
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are DNA structural transactions during genome maintenance, covering topological and geometric change, fork reversal, R-loop processing, protein-DNA complex removal and repair pathway choice, which are coordinated by the PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation and chromatin remodelling at damage sites in the additional set.

reading_2.theme: DNA repair at replication forks with ADP-ribosylation and chromatin
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the DNA-structural side of genome maintenance, topological change, fork reversal, R-loop processing and repair pathway choice, regulated by PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation and chromatin remodelling.

shared: positive regulation of hemoglobin biosynthetic process

reading_1.theme: Erythroid heme synthesis, iron handling and gas transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are heme biosynthesis and Fe-S cluster assembly, framed as supplying heme for hemoglobin during erythropoiesis within iron uptake, heme scavenging and oxygen/CO2 transport.

reading_2.theme: Erythroid heme synthesis, iron handling and gas transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are heme and porphyrin biosynthesis with mitochondrial ABC transport and Fe-S assembly, serving here as hemoglobin production for erythrocytes whose iron uptake, oxygen/CO2 exchange and Rh-mediated ammonium transport make up the rest of the theme.

shared: IRAK1 recruits IKK complex upon TLR7/8 or 9 stimulation
positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction
IKK complex recruitment mediated by RIP1

reading_1.theme: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kB signalling and its regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover canonical IKK recruitment and NF-kB activation downstream of TLR/IRAK1 and RIP1, plus SUMOylation of immune proteins. This is the central activation step among TNFR1, CD40 and NIK-driven non-canonical signalling, ubiquitin control and IKK-deficiency immunodeficiencies.

reading_2.theme: TLR adaptor signalling to IKK, NF-kB and TAK1
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe IRAK1/RIP1-mediated IKK recruitment and canonical NF-kB activation, framed here as the NF-kB arm of MyD88- and TRIF-dependent Toll-like receptor signalling that also drives TAK1, IRF activation and programmed cell death.

shared: apoptotic process involved in heart morphogenesis
regulation of secondary heart field cardioblast proliferation

reading_1.theme: Second heart field-driven cardiac morphogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover specification, proliferation and differentiation of second heart field progenitors. These cells build the right ventricle, the septum and the ascending aorta/outflow, with endocardial and mesenchymal contributions to valve morphogenesis.

reading_2.theme: Embryonic heart morphogenesis and cardiac lineage specification
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the core cardiogenesis programme, covering secondary heart field specification and proliferation, cardiomyocyte, endocardial and septal cell differentiation, ventricle and outflow (ascending aorta) formation, which the additional terms extend to valve and endocardial cushion mesenchyme morphogenesis.

reading_1.theme: Tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ synthesis and reactive aldehyde detoxification
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and repair of glycated proteins, a redox damage-control arm that the theme pairs with tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ metabolism.

reading_2.theme: Reactive carbonyl detoxification and NAD+ redox metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover detoxification of methylglyoxal and aldehydes and repair of glycated proteins. This is carbonyl-stress defence, set beside NAD+ synthesis from tryptophan and salvage, which supplies redox cofactors.

reading_1.theme: Oxidative stress, ischaemia and ferroptotic cell death
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe cellular responses to peroxides, hydrogen sulfide and ischaemia, framed as oxidative stress whose iron-dependent lipid peroxidation can culminate in ferroptosis.

reading_2.theme: Oxidative and hypoxic stress responses and cell death
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the sensing of oxidative and hypoxic insults (H2O2, hydroperoxides, H2S, ischemia, oxygen), which the theme links to regulation of stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis.

shared: positive regulation of Arp2/3 complex-mediated actin nucleation
RHO GTPases Activate WASPs and WAVEs

reading_1.theme: Rho GTPase-driven actin remodelling for cell motility
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the Rac/Rho GTPase-to-Arp2/3 and formin nucleation signals that build lamellipodia, framed as the upstream drivers of leading-edge actin dynamics, migration and macropinocytosis.

reading_2.theme: Actin cytoskeleton dynamics in cell migration
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe Rho GTPase-driven actin nucleation through WASP/WAVE, Arp2/3 and formins forming lamellipodia, the protrusive engine of cell motility and macropinocytosis.

shared: negative regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
obsolete neuron projection extension involved in neuron projection guidance
positive regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance

reading_1.theme: Axon guidance by repulsive and attractive cues
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the growth-cone outputs of guidance, semaphorin-driven repulsion and positive or negative control of axon extension, on which netrin, ephrin, Slit-Robo and L1 signalling converge.

reading_2.theme: Axon guidance and collateral sprouting
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Sema3A-driven chemorepulsion and positive/negative control of axon extension, framed as guidance cues that steer axon growth and branching.

shared: positive regulation of natural killer cell differentiation
regulation of natural killer cell proliferation

reading_1.theme: Cytokine signalling regulating NK and lymphocyte responses
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover IL-15 and IL-21 common gamma-chain cytokine signalling driving NK cell proliferation and differentiation. This sits within a broader cytokine network (IL-10, IL-12/23/27, IL-20 family, interferons) shaping NK/NKT activation and inflammation.

reading_2.theme: Cytokine signalling shaping NK/NKT and inflammatory responses
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover common gamma-chain cytokines (IL-15, IL-21) driving NK cell proliferation and differentiation. Here they sit inside a wider JAK-STAT network of IL-12-family, IL-10-family and type I/III interferon signalling that tunes lymphocyte activation and inflammation.

shared: negative regulation of neuron projection regeneration
positive regulation of neuron projection regeneration

reading_1.theme: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting after injury
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame the positive and negative control of injured-axon regrowth, including RHOA-mediated growth inhibition, within broader regulation of axon cytoskeleton and branching.

reading_2.theme: Axon regeneration, sprouting and cytoskeletal control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are injury-induced axon regeneration and sprouting with RhoA-mediated growth inhibition, framed within neuronal cytoskeletal control of axon growth, calibre and branching.

shared: Regulation of glycolysis by fructose 2,6-bisphosphate metabolism
Defective HK1 causes hexokinase deficiency (HK deficiency)

reading_1.theme: Glycolysis and its regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the glycolytic flux from glucose to lactate and its fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control (with oxygen transport), forming the glycolytic pathway itself that the additional regulators link to the pentose phosphate shunt and nucleotide turnover.

reading_2.theme: Glucose, fructose and glycogen carbohydrate metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are glycolysis and its fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation to lactate (with erythrocyte oxygen transport and hexokinase deficiency), framed as the central catabolic spine of a carbohydrate network that also includes gluconeogenesis, glycogen storage and fructose metabolism and their inherited disorders.

shared: positive regulation of G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle

reading_1.theme: E2F-driven G1/S cell cycle transcription
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the E2F transcription network promoting the G1/S transition, the transcriptional switch (and its repression by E2F6, DREAM and pocket proteins) that licenses DNA replication and cell cycle progression.

reading_2.theme: E2F-driven cell cycle transcription
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are E2F transcriptional control of the G1/S transition, including E2F6-mediated repression, framed as the core transcriptional switch of the proliferation programme.

shared: Defective SLC5A1 causes congenital glucose/galactose malabsorption (GGM)

reading_1.theme: Dietary sugar digestion and hexose absorption
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe carbohydrate digestion and intestinal/renal hexose transport with their transporter deficiencies, framed as uptake of dietary sugars alongside related glycoside transport.

reading_2.theme: SLC transporter-mediated epithelial nutrient transport and its disorders
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the carbohydrate arm of epithelial solute handling, covering dietary sugar digestion, intestinal and renal hexose uptake and the SGLT/GLUT defect disorders, alongside the amino acid, urate and organic anion carriers.

shared: Processing of antigen in germinal center B cells
regulation of antigen processing and presentation of peptide or polysaccharide antigen via MHC class II
regulation of antigen processing and presentation of peptide antigen
negative regulation of antigen processing and presentation
antigen processing and presentation of exogenous peptide antigen via MHC class II
antigen processing and presentation, endogenous lipid antigen via MHC class Ib
peptide antigen assembly with MHC class II protein complex

reading_1.theme: Antigen presentation and cytotoxic T/NK cell recognition
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe MHC class II and lipid antigen processing and presentation, framed as the antigen-presenting side of adaptive recognition alongside MHC I cross-presentation, NK/T cytotoxicity and viral immune evasion.

reading_2.theme: Antigen processing and MHC presentation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are MHC class II and lipid antigen processing and presentation and their regulation, framed as the core function of professional antigen-presenting cells such as dendritic cells and monocytes.

shared: aspartate family amino acid biosynthetic process

reading_1.theme: Methionine cycle and cobalamin/folate one-carbon metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the methionine/SAM cycle and its inherited defects, framed as the methylation endpoint that depends on cobalamin and folate supply for remethylation of homocysteine.

reading_2.theme: One-carbon metabolism: methionine cycle, folate and cobalamin
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the methionine/SAM cycle and methionine salvage, including its inborn errors (MAT1A, AHCY, MTR, MTRR). Here they are the methyl-donor hub whose remethylation step depends on folate and cobalamin, the uptake, transport and disorders of which make up the additional pathways.

shared: RUNX2 regulates genes involved in differentiation of myeloid cells
RUNX1 regulates transcription of genes involved in interleukin signaling
RUNX1 regulates transcription of genes involved in BCR signaling
RUNX1 regulates transcription of genes involved in WNT signaling
RUNX1 regulates transcription of genes involved in differentiation of myeloid cells

reading_1.theme: RUNX family transcriptional regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are RUNX1/2/3 regulation of genes for myeloid differentiation, BCR, interleukin and WNT signalling, framed as RUNX-driven haematopoietic transcription.

reading_2.theme: RUNX-regulated transcription in myeloid and granulocyte differentiation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe RUNX1/2/3 transcriptional programmes, framed as master regulators of myeloid progenitor commitment and granulopoiesis together with G-CSF signalling.

shared: cellular response to prostaglandin E stimulus
negative regulation of prostaglandin biosynthetic process
positive regulation of prostaglandin biosynthetic process

reading_1.theme: Arachidonic acid–derived eicosanoid synthesis and signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the COX and P450 epoxygenase/omega-oxidation branches producing prostaglandins, thromboxanes and hepoxilins and their regulation (fever, PGE response), framed within the broader eicosanoid and fatty-acid oxygenation network including lipoxygenase and HETE pathways.

reading_2.theme: Eicosanoid and specialised pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the cyclooxygenase and P450 epoxygenase branches of arachidonic acid metabolism producing prostanoids and their receptors, alongside the lipoxygenase leukotriene, lipoxin and resolvin branches.

shared: positive regulation of insulin-like growth factor receptor signaling pathway
regulation of growth hormone receptor signaling pathway
positive regulation of multicellular organism growth
negative regulation of multicellular organism growth
growth hormone receptor signaling pathway via JAK-STAT

reading_1.theme: Endocrine control of body growth and metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and IGF receptor signalling via JAK-STAT, framed as the somatotropic and metabolic hormone axis interacting with HPA-axis glucocorticoid secretion.

reading_2.theme: Neuroendocrine hormone control of growth and stress
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cytokine-class hormone receptor signalling (GH, prolactin, leptin, IGF) via JAK-STAT that regulates body growth, set alongside the HPA glucocorticoid axis.

shared: positive regulation of myeloid leukocyte mediated immunity

reading_1.theme: Myeloid inflammatory activation and neutrophil degranulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the generic myeloid inflammatory effector response, neutrophil degranulation, complement and TLR signalling, of monocytes and neutrophils.

reading_2.theme: Myeloid innate inflammation and neutrophil degranulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are inflammatory and TLR signalling with neutrophil degranulation and complement receptor signalling, the core innate activation program of neutrophils, monocytes and dendritic cells.

shared: DNA synthesis involved in DNA repair
replication-born double-strand break repair via sister chromatid exchange

reading_1.theme: Recombinational repair of replication-associated DNA breaks
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover repair DNA synthesis and sister-chromatid-exchange repair of replication-born double-strand breaks. These are recombination-based fork repair steps, together with strand invasion, SDSA, fork reversal, interstrand cross-link repair and DNA topology changes.

reading_2.theme: Replication-coupled DNA damage tolerance and repair synthesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the general DNA-repair and repair-synthesis umbrella (including sister-chromatid-exchange break repair), framing the replication fork, translesion polymerases and gap-filling machinery as instruments of DNA repair.

reading_1.theme: Gluconeogenesis and interconnected sugar and pyruvate metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways (alanine and oxaloacetate metabolism, gluconeogenesis) are framed here as the pyruvate/oxaloacetate-to-glucose route that connects amino-acid carbon to the fructose, glycerol, pentose-phosphate and glucuronate pathways of central carbohydrate metabolism.

reading_2.theme: Amino acid catabolism feeding gluconeogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the alanine-to-oxaloacetate route into gluconeogenesis, alongside threonine, choline and carnitine-related amino acid metabolism.

shared: Defective SLC35A2 causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2M (CDG2M)
positive regulation of leukocyte tethering or rolling
Formation of the active cofactor, UDP-glucuronate
Defective SLC35A1 in sialic acid metabolism causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2F (CDG2F)
Defective SLC35C1 causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2C (CDG2C)
Reactions specific to the hybrid N-glycan synthesis pathway
Defective transport by SLC35A1 causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2F (CDG2F)
Reactions specific to the complex N-glycan synthesis pathway
obsolete protein N-linked glycosylation via asparagine
Progressive trimming of alpha-1,2-linked mannose residues from Man9/8/7GlcNAc2 to produce Man5GlcNAc2
Defective SLC35A3 causes arthrogryposis, mental retardation, and seizures (AMRS)
hematopoietic stem cell migration to bone marrow
Defective SLC17A5 causes Salla disease (SD) and ISSD

reading_1.theme: Protein and lipid glycosylation in the Golgi
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe N- and O-glycan, sialyl/fucosyl, blood-group and glycosphingolipid synthesis with nucleotide-sugar transport, framed as the general glycosylation machinery that extends to proteoglycan/GAG, dystroglycan and Notch glycosylation and their disorders.

reading_2.theme: Protein and lipid glycosylation and glycosylation disorders
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Golgi glycan elaboration on N- and O-glycoproteins and glycolipids, meaning nucleotide-sugar transport, fucosylation, sialylation, blood-group (ABO, Lewis) antigen and selectin-ligand synthesis, and their congenital defects, which this theme places beside proteoglycan GAG chain synthesis and O-mannosyl dystroglycan glycosylation.

shared: Regulation of TP53 Activity through Methylation

reading_1.theme: Protein methylation linked to ribosome biogenesis and translation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover lysine and arginine methylation of proteins, including p53, responding to methionine availability. Here this is a nutrient-sensitive modification layer regulating ribosome biogenesis and cap-dependent translation initiation.

reading_2.theme: Protein methylation and translational machinery modification
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe lysine and arginine methylation of proteins (including p53) and its link to ribosome biogenesis and methionine sensing, framed here as one of the post-translational and tRNA modification systems that tune translation and its fidelity.

shared: microglial cell activation involved in immune response
negative regulation of long-term synaptic potentiation
negative regulation of microglial cell activation
positive regulation of microglial cell migration

reading_1.theme: Microglial neuroinflammation in amyloid-associated neurodegeneration
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe microglial activation, migration, proliferation and cytotoxicity in response to amyloid-beta, framed as the neuroinflammatory driver of hippocampal neuron death and synaptic impairment.

reading_2.theme: Microglial response to amyloid and apoptotic cell clearance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are microglial activation, proliferation and cytotoxicity in response to amyloid-beta with neuronal and synaptic damage, framed alongside DAP12/TREM2-type efferocytosis of apoptotic cells.

shared: metanephric part of ureteric bud development
positive regulation of epithelial tube formation
regulation of branching involved in ureteric bud morphogenesis

reading_1.theme: Kidney organogenesis: ureteric bud and nephron development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe the ureteric bud and mesonephric duct side of early kidney formation, its outgrowth, elongation and branching, which induces nephron formation from the metanephric mesenchyme.

reading_2.theme: Kidney organogenesis: ureteric bud branching and nephron patterning
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways capture the early inductive events (intermediate mesoderm, ureteric bud elongation and branching, renal vesicle formation) that precede nephron segmentation and collecting duct, loop of Henle and S-shaped body morphogenesis.

shared: IRF3 mediated activation of type 1 IFN
IRF3-mediated induction of type I IFN
positive regulation of type I interferon-mediated signaling pathway
regulation of AIM2 inflammasome complex assembly
positive regulation of defense response to virus by host

reading_1.theme: Cytosolic DNA sensing and antiviral type I interferon induction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover the effector outputs of cytosolic nucleic-acid sensors: IRF3-driven type I interferon, ZBP1/RIP-mediated NF-kB activation and AIM2 inflammasome assembly. They are how cGAS/STING-type DNA sensing becomes antiviral defense.

reading_2.theme: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing and antiviral type I interferon
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe IRF3- and ZBP1-mediated induction of type I interferon and AIM2 regulation, the antiviral output of cytosolic DNA sensing via cGAS/STING.

shared: aspartate family amino acid biosynthetic process

reading_1.theme: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamate/glutamine/aspartate interconversion via 2-oxoglutarate and nitrogen handling, framed as amino acid metabolism coupled to mitochondrial redox through the malate-aspartate shuttle.

reading_2.theme: Nitrogen metabolism: glutamate, aspartate and urea cycle
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen handling, framed as the supplier of ammonia and aspartate nitrogen to the urea cycle and its disorders.

reading_1.theme: Post-translational and tRNA residue modification for translation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are protein hydroxylation of lysine/proline residues, framed as one type of amino-acid side-chain modification alongside tRNA modification, hypusination and diphthamide synthesis that support translation.

reading_2.theme: Post-translational hydroxylation and methylation of residues
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are proline and lysine hydroxylation, framed as a class of amino-acid side-chain modifications alongside lysine methylation.

shared: epigenetic programming in the zygotic pronuclei
Chromatin modifications during the maternal to zygotic transition (MZT)
M-decay: degradation of maternal mRNAs by maternally stored factors
Z-decay: degradation of maternal mRNAs by zygotically expressed factors
POU5F1 (OCT4), SOX2, NANOG activate genes related to proliferation

reading_1.theme: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and early embryonic development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the oocyte-to-embryo handover, covering clearance of maternal mRNAs, zygotic genome activation, epigenetic reprogramming of the pronuclei, cleavage, and the first lineage decisions (pluripotency, trophectoderm, primordial germ cells), which lead into inner cell mass and implantation events.

reading_2.theme: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and early embryonic lineage specification
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe maternal mRNA clearance, zygotic genome activation and first lineage choices (trophectoderm, germ cells, pluripotency), framed as the core of pre-implantation development leading to inner cell mass formation.

shared: co-transcriptional mRNA 3'-end processing, cleavage and polyadenylation pathway

reading_1.theme: Pre-mRNA 3'-end processing and RNA maturation and decay
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe cleavage and polyadenylation of pre-mRNAs, framed here as the 3'-end maturation step within a broader nuclear RNA-processing system including histone mRNA stem-loop processing, splicing, transcription termination, capping and mRNA decay.

reading_2.theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and translation-coupled mRNA surveillance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are mRNA cleavage and polyadenylation, framed as the 3'-end formation that defines where translation terminates and so feeds nonsense-mediated and non-stop decay surveillance.

shared: negative regulation of stress-activated protein kinase signaling cascade
negative regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator
negative regulation of intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway by p53 class mediator

reading_1.theme: Cellular senescence under oxidative and p53 stress
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe stress-induced senescence with dampening of p53-dependent apoptosis and stress kinase signalling, framed as a choice of senescent arrest rather than death, with SASP and Polycomb-controlled entry.

reading_2.theme: Stress-induced senescence and p53 damage-response restraint
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe oxidative stress-induced senescence with suppression of p53-mediated apoptosis and stress kinase signalling, framed as the cell-fate response to UV and DNA damage that favours arrest over death.

shared: establishment of protein localization to chromatin

reading_1.theme: Chromatin assembly and ATP-dependent chromatin remodelling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are replication-coupled nucleosome deposition and organization, the chromatin packaging substrate that BAF and CHD remodelling complexes reorganize during replication, repair and stem cell maintenance.

reading_2.theme: Chromatin assembly and SWI/SNF remodelling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are nucleosome assembly and protein recruitment to chromatin during replication, set beside the assembly of BAF and CHD chromatin remodelling complexes and their roles in stem cell maintenance and DNA repair.

reading_1.theme: tRNA and protein modifications supporting translational fidelity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are tRNA anticodon modifications and aminoacylation ensuring decoding fidelity, alongside wybutosine, diphthamide and protein hydroxylation modifications of translation components.

reading_2.theme: tRNA and translation-factor modifications ensuring translational fidelity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are tRNA anticodon modifications (t6A, wobble guanine) and aminoacylation that maintain decoding accuracy, framed here together with wybutosine, diphthamide and hydroxylation modifications of tRNA and translation-related proteins.

shared: Thrombin signalling through proteinase activated receptors (PARs)

reading_1.theme: Platelet activation and degranulation in hemostasis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe platelet activation via thrombin/PAR and ADP/P2Y receptors and granule secretion, framed as hemostasis supported by integrin adhesion and cytoskeletal remodelling.

reading_2.theme: Platelet activation and blood coagulation (hemostasis)
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover platelet activation by thrombin and ADP and degranulation, framed as the cellular arm of hemostasis coordinated with platelet adhesion, the coagulation cascade and fibrinolysis.

shared: positive regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome

reading_1.theme: Pre-mRNA splicing and snRNA biogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways name the spliceosome and its regulation plus snRNA cap hypermethylation, i.e. the core splicing machinery and snRNP maturation that the additional snRNA transcription and spliceosome assembly steps build up and regulate.

reading_2.theme: Spliceosome assembly and snRNA production for mRNA splicing
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are spliceosome activity and snRNA cap hypermethylation, framed as the snRNP maturation and core splicing step fed by Pol II/III snRNA transcription and tri-snRNP assembly.

shared: positive regulation of T-helper 1 type immune response
positive regulation of type II interferon production

reading_1.theme: Th1 differentiation and IL-12/IFN-gamma response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are Th1 effector cytokine production (IFN-gamma, IL-12, GM-CSF), the output of Th1 polarization driven by IL-12/STAT signalling and feeding IFN-gamma signalling.

reading_2.theme: IL-12 and IFN-gamma driven Th1 immune response
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Th1-polarizing cytokine outputs (IL-12, IFN-gamma, GM-CSF), framed as the effector signals of Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma signalling.

shared: RNA Pol II CTD phosphorylation and interaction with CE during HIV infection
transcription pausing by RNA polymerase II
Formation of the Early Elongation Complex
Formation of RNA Pol II elongation complex
Abortive elongation of HIV-1 transcript in the absence of Tat

reading_1.theme: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation, pausing and elongation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe promoter-proximal Pol II pausing, CTD phosphorylation and early elongation complex formation, framed as the host transcription checkpoint that HIV Tat exploits to drive viral transcription.

reading_2.theme: RNA Pol II promoter-proximal pausing and elongation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are early elongation complex formation, CTD phosphorylation and pausing (including the HIV Tat context), framed as the pause-release checkpoint in RNA Pol II transcription elongation.

shared: Sodium-coupled sulphate, di- and tri-carboxylate transporters
Organic anion transport by SLC5/17/25 transporters

reading_1.theme: Membrane transport of carboxylate metabolites
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are sodium-coupled transport of di- and tricarboxylates such as succinate and citrate, the TCA-intermediate part of organic anion and metabolite transport (e.g. in proximal tubule) alongside pyruvate, monocarboxylate and carnitine carriers.

reading_2.theme: Membrane transport of metabolic carboxylates and carnitine
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are sodium-coupled SLC13/SLC25-type carriers moving succinate and other TCA-cycle di/tricarboxylates, framed here as one arm of a broader system shuttling fuel intermediates (pyruvate, monocarboxylates, alpha-ketoglutarate, carnitine) across membranes, notably in the kidney proximal tubule.

shared: negative regulation of natural killer cell activation
positive regulation of natural killer cell cytokine production

reading_1.theme: NK cell regulation and cytotoxicity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are KIR-mediated inhibitory control of NK cell activation and tolerance, balanced against granzyme cytotoxicity and MHC class Ib recognition.

reading_2.theme: NK cell receptor-mediated activation and inhibitory tolerance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame NK cells, via KIR-type receptors, as balancing cytokine-producing activation against inhibitory restraint that enforces peripheral tolerance, the same inhibitory logic extended in the additional pathways to restraining T cell cytotoxicity.

regulation of cardiac muscle cell membrane potential
regulation of heart rate by cardiac conduction

regulation of ventricular cardiac muscle cell action potential
membrane depolarization during SA node cell action potential
regulation of atrial cardiac muscle cell membrane depolarization
obsolete cell-cell signaling involved in cardiac conduction
regulation of ventricular cardiac muscle cell membrane depolarization
bundle of His cell to Purkinje myocyte signaling

reading_1.theme: Cardiac electrophysiology and calcium handling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the cardiac action potential phases, pacemaking and conduction through SA/AV nodes and the His-Purkinje system, framed as the electrical excitation that, through ion channels and calcium handling, drives contraction.

reading_2.theme: Cardiac action potential, conduction and calcium-handling excitation-contraction
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe cardiac electrophysiology, the action potential phases, pacemaker and conduction-system depolarization, HCN channels and intercalated-disc coupling, which here drive the calcium release, K+/Ca2+ channel and exchanger regulation of heart contraction and relaxation.

shared: Organic anion transport by SLC22 transporters

reading_1.theme: Urate and fructose transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are SLC2A9- and SLC22-mediated urate handling and its hypouricemia defects, framed as renal and intestinal urate transport linked to fructose uptake, which raises urate.

reading_2.theme: Renal urate transport and fructose handling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are urate handling by the renal SLC2A9/GLUT9 and SLC22 organic anion transporters and its loss in hereditary hypouricemia, which this theme ties to fructose transport and intestinal hexose absorption through the dual urate/fructose transporter GLUT9 and fructose-driven urate production.

shared: negative regulation of multicellular organism growth
positive regulation of multicellular organism growth

reading_1.theme: Hormonal control of organism growth
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are leptin signalling and regulation of body growth, framed as part of the growth hormone/IGF JAK-STAT axis controlling organismal growth.

reading_2.theme: Endocrine control of body growth: leptin, GH, IGF
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are leptin signalling and positive and negative regulation of organism growth, read as part of the GH/JAK-STAT/IGF somatotropic axis.

reading_1.theme: Germinal centre B cell maturation into antibody-secreting plasma cells
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell, germinal-centre, Tfh and plasma-cell differentiation programmes, which this theme frames as the T-dependent humoral response that culminates in class-switched IgG/IgA antibody production.

reading_2.theme: Germinal centre B cell maturation into plasma and memory cells
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways denote germinal centre B differentiation with T follicular helper support and plasma cell output, framed within broad B cell identity, activation, co-stimulation (ICOS, CD27) and memory programmes.

shared: positive regulation of intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway in response to DNA damage
positive regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator
Autodegradation of the E3 ubiquitin ligase COP1
positive regulation of intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway by p53 class mediator
Regulation of TP53 Activity through Phosphorylation
Loss of function of TP53 in cancer due to loss of tetramerization ability

reading_1.theme: p53 activation in DNA damage, apoptosis and cell-cycle control
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover activation of p53 by phosphorylation and its pro-apoptotic DNA-damage output. This tumour-suppressor node, when lost (TP53 mutation, p14ARF defects), lets cells evade senescence, apoptosis and cell-cycle checkpoints.

reading_2.theme: p53-mediated DNA damage response and cell-cycle checkpoints
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are p53 activation and its control (phosphorylation, COP1, tetramerization loss) driving damage-induced apoptosis, within cell-cycle checkpoint control and ARF-dependent tumour suppression.

shared: Binding and entry of HIV virion
Integration of viral DNA into host genomic DNA
Autointegration results in viral DNA circles
LRR FLII-interacting protein 1 (LRRFIP1) activates type I IFN production
APOBEC3G mediated resistance to HIV-1 infection

reading_1.theme: HIV and herpesvirus replication cycle and host restriction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover the early retroviral life cycle (entry, uncoating, reverse transcription, nuclear import, integration, latency), host restriction such as APOBEC3G, and control of viral transcription. Late-stage assembly and Nef/Vpu-mediated immune evasion complete the viral cycle.

reading_2.theme: Viral replication cycle and host restriction
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the HIV early life cycle (entry, uncoating, reverse transcription, nuclear import, integration) and host control of viral transcription and latency, the replication phase that host restriction factors and immune evasion act upon.

shared: obsolete protein N-linked glycosylation via asparagine
attachment of GPI anchor to protein

reading_1.theme: Dolichol pathway and N-linked glycosylation with CDGs
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are dolichyl-phosphate and nucleotide-sugar synthesis and lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly, framed as the early N-glycosylation steps whose defects cause congenital disorders of glycosylation.

reading_2.theme: Nucleotide-sugar and dolichol supply for glycosylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover synthesis of dolichol-linked precursors and nucleotide sugars (UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose) for N-glycosylation and GPI anchoring, with their congenital defects, framed as the sugar-donor supply that also includes sialic acid and CMP-sialic acid metabolism.

shared: positive regulation of MAPKKK cascade by fibroblast growth factor receptor signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: FGFR4-betaKlotho endocrine FGF signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe betaKlotho-dependent ligand binding and FGFR4 FRS/SHC-MAPK cascades, framed as the endocrine FGF branch within general FGFR1-4 signalling.

reading_2.theme: FGFR4/Klotho signalling to MAPK, PI3K and PLC
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are betaKlotho-dependent FGFR4 activation and its FRS/SHC-to-MAPK branch, framed as one arm alongside PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades downstream of FGF receptors.

shared: co-transcriptional mRNA 3'-end processing, cleavage and polyadenylation pathway

reading_1.theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA turnover
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are cleavage and polyadenylation of pre-mRNAs, framed as the 3'-end maturation step that is counterbalanced by decapping and exonucleolytic mRNA decay.

reading_2.theme: Pre-mRNA 3'-end processing including histone mRNA
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe cleavage and polyadenylation of intronless and polyadenylated pre-mRNAs, framed here as the canonical 3'-end route that parallels SLBP-dependent stem-loop processing of histone mRNAs and is coupled to Pol II termination.

shared: positive regulation of MAPKKK cascade by fibroblast growth factor receptor signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: FGF receptor signalling cascades
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe FGFR4 signalling via FRS2/SHC to MAPK and betaKlotho-dependent ligand binding, framed as one receptor's arm within FGFR family PI3K and PLC-gamma signalling.

reading_2.theme: FGFR4/Klotho signalling to MAPK, PI3K and PLC
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are betaKlotho-dependent FGFR4 activation and its FRS/SHC-to-MAPK branch, framed as one arm alongside PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades downstream of FGF receptors.

shared: response to cell cycle checkpoint signaling
mitotic intra-S DNA damage checkpoint signaling
TP53 Regulates Transcription of DNA Repair Genes

reading_1.theme: Homologous recombination repair of DNA double-strand breaks
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame genome-stability control, checkpoint signalling and resolution of recombination intermediates as the regulatory and end-stage steps of homologous-recombination-based double-strand break and cross-link repair during replication and mitosis.

reading_2.theme: DNA damage checkpoints and homologous recombination repair
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe checkpoint signalling, p53-driven repair gene expression and resolution of recombination intermediates that maintain genome stability, framing them as the control layer over homologous recombination repair.

Defective SLC35A1 in sialic acid metabolism causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2F (CDG2F)

attachment of GPI anchor to protein

reading_1.theme: Glycoconjugate biosynthesis and lysosomal glycan catabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe nucleotide-sugar and sialic acid synthesis, GPI anchor and glycosphingolipid/ganglioside biosynthesis and their defects, framed here as the anabolic half of glycoconjugate turnover whose N-glycan processing and lysosomal degradation (hexosaminidase, sialidase deficiencies) form the additional set.

reading_2.theme: Nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport for glycoconjugates
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid and UDP-glucose, GPI anchoring and glycosphingolipid synthesis, framed as the sugar-donor supply and its use whose Golgi transport by SLC35 carriers fails in CDGs.
